description:
🚀 THE KILLER FEATURE: Copy and paste any curl command - it just works!

CurlDotNet brings the power of curl to .NET. Simply paste any curl command string and execute it directly. No translation needed, no shell execution, pure .NET.

✨ Key Features:
• Paste ANY curl command - works with or without "curl" prefix
• All 300+ curl options supported
• Stream-based for memory efficiency
• Perfect for CI/CD pipelines
• Every curl error code has its own exception type
• Middleware and DI support

📦 Supported Platforms:
• .NET 10.0 (future-ready, opt-in support!)
• .NET 9.0 (latest & greatest!)
• .NET 8.0 (current LTS)
• .NET Framework 4.8 (Windows, Mac, Linux via Mono)
• .NET Framework 4.7.2+ (Windows)
• .NET Standard 2.0 (maximum compatibility)
• Xamarin, Unity, Blazor, MAUI

💎 Proudly sponsored by IronSoftware (ironsoftware.com), creators of IronPDF, IronOCR, IronXL, and IronBarcode.
releaseNotes:
Version 9.8.11 - every runnable curl test passes (631 of 631), checked against real curl on Linux

PARITY: all 631 runnable HTTP tests from curl's own suite pass (286 byte-exact); known-failures.txt is empty.
   The replay now also compares standard error, applies curl's stripfile/strippart rules, and its stub
   server behaves like curl's sws. tests/CurlDotNet.CurlSuite/reference builds real curl from the same
   commit in Docker and runs curl's own runtests.pl, so every disputed behaviour is settled from curl's logs.
NEW: CurlResult.Warnings / CurlException.Warnings (curl's exact Warning:/Note: lines), CurlException.CurlErrorMessage
   (curl's own error text, also used by -w %{errormsg}), CurlException.IsUsageError (exit 2 usage errors)
NEW: CurlFlavor.Native - read commands with the shell of the operating system (cmd.exe on Windows, bash elsewhere);
   Auto stays the default
NEW: --haproxy-protocol and --haproxy-clientip (.NET 5+), -#/--progress-bar draws curl's bar, -D % writes to stderr,
   opt-in Curl.DefaultReadConfigFile reads ~/.curlrc like curl (off by default), -w on file:// URLs
FIXED: proxy NTLM through CONNECT tunnels negotiated by CurlDotNet with curl's exact bytes; first header line starting
   with whitespace; two user Connection headers; connection reuse across --next with a same-host --connect-to;
   TLS handshake inside --connect-timeout is exit 28 with -w connection facts; bad hosts such as domain..tld mapped
   by --resolve; redirects with close-delimited bodies no longer wait for EOF; tracing never changes wire bytes;
   gzip/deflate errors (exit 61) and multi-member gzip (exit 23) like curl; multipart Content-Type and empty
   names like curl; %{size_delivered}; %{header_json} layout; --retry-max-time uses a monotonic clock
TESTS: CI and test-all-locally.csx run the whole unit project (2073 tests) with no category filter

Version 9.8.2 - documentation site navigation fix (folder URLs redirect to their own pages); library unchanged since 9.8.0

Version 9.8.0 - curl parity release: tested against curl's own test suite

PARITY: tests/CurlDotNet.CurlSuite replays 1,092 HTTP tests from curl's own suite against a local stub
   server and compares the exact bytes on the wire. 607 of 620 runnable tests pass (97.9%), 216 byte-exact;
   the 13 remaining are documented in known-failures.txt (HttpClient CONNECT/NTLM, .NET URI rules, no ~/.curlrc).
NEW: complete curl 8.7.1 option table; combined short flags (-sSL), attached values (-ofile, -m10), --long=value,
   --url, --next, multiple URLs, {a,b}/[1-3] globbing with #1 in -o, -K config files, --variable, .netrc, -G, -T,
   -z, -r multi-ranges, --oauth2-bearer, --http1.0/1.1/2, --request-target, --connect-to, --resolve, --path-as-is
NEW: curl flavors - CurlFlavor.Auto/Posix/WindowsCmd/PowerShell/InvokeWebRequest. Commands pasted from bash,
   Windows CMD, PowerShell or PowerShell's Invoke-WebRequest alias are detected and read with that shell's rules
   (Curl.ExecuteAsync(cmd, CurlFlavor.PowerShell), Curl.DefaultFlavor, Curl.DetectFlavor)
NEW: cookie engine (-b FILE, -c JAR, -j, Netscape jars), curl-exact multipart (-F ;type= ;filename= <file --form-string),
   -D/-J/--output-dir/--create-dirs/--no-clobber/-R/-C -, every -w variable incl. %{json}, --retry family with
   Retry-After, --limit-rate/--speed-limit, --cacert/--capath/--cert/--key/--pinnedpubkey/--tlsv1.x (.NET 5+)
NEW: pure-C# Digest and NTLM negotiation matching curl byte for byte; --anyauth; proxy auth; Proxy-Connection,
   preemptive proxy Basic, --noproxy/NO_PROXY, http_proxy env vars, --socks4/4a/5/5-hostname, -p CONNECT tunnels
NEW: curl exit codes as typed exceptions (2, 3, 5-8, 18, 22, 23, 26, 28, 33, 35, 43, 47, 49, 52, 56, 60, 61, 63, 77,
   90, 94, 100); every exception says what happened, how to fix it and links the documentation
NEW: Curl.ExecuteAsync(CurlOptions), Curl.DefaultUserAgent (curl/8.7.1 like curl), Accept: */* default,
   -H "Name:" suppression, CurlException.StandardOutput, CurlOptions.UnknownOptions/UnsupportedOptions
NEW: full XML documentation on every public member (parameters, formats, defaults, worked examples, cross-links)
FIX: (#45) Post/PostJson/Download helpers no longer break on quotes or spaces
FIX: --compressed only sends Accept-Encoding when asked; -o leaves Body empty like curl; -i -o writes headers to
   the file; -L turns POST into GET on 301/302/303 and strips Authorization across hosts; --max-redirs exact
FIX: no hidden 30 s / 100 s timeouts; --max-time covers the body; --connect-timeout enforced; decimals accepted
FIX: cancellation is OperationCanceledException; LibCurl returns failed results instead of throwing and honours
   proxy/-k/redirect settings; CurlSettings Proxy/UserAgent/Cookies/OnRedirect/Progress/Retries now apply
FIX: ParseJson is case-insensitive; AsJsonDynamic returns a real dynamic object; credentials masked in logs
PACKAGE: net10.0 added; unused Ninject and System.CommandLine dependencies removed
TESTS: 1,788 unit tests run offline in seconds against an in-process server (no fixed ports, no internet)
Frameworks: netstandard2.0, net472, net48, net8.0, net9.0, net10.0
